Multiplayer

Sign in and queue up: we match you with up to three other players, run a ready check, and draft your animals before the match. Or use a private room code below — that is the Custom Game.

Host a game and read the room code to your guest — or type in a host's code and join theirs. The other two teams are AI pilots. Both computers run the same match in lockstep (the StarCraft way): only your orders cross the network, so both players get the identical game at the identical speed.

This is the name other players will know you by — in lobbies, the draft, matches and the results table. Your Google name is never shown to other players.
